id: \rMay: Great timing \PN. I just lost my first contest. I need more experience if I want to become a great Coordinator. Care to help out?
en: \rMay: Great timing \PN. I just lost my first contest. I need more experience if I want to become a great Coordinator. Care to help out?
it: \rVera: Arrivi al momento giusto, \PN. Ho appena perso la mia prima Gara. Mi serve più esperienza se voglio diventare una grande Coordinatrice. Ti va di darmi una mano?

id: \rMay: I think I picked up a few things. Thanks for your help.
en: \rMay: I think I picked up a few things. Thanks for your help.
it: \rVera: Credo di aver imparato qualcosa. Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Magic Room.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Magic Room.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città, ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Magicozona.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.

id: \bYou're friends with May, huh? I guess I have time to beat you too.
en: \bYou're friends with May, huh? I guess I have time to beat you too.
it: \bSei amico di Vera, eh? Direi che ho tempo di battere anche te.

id: \bI'm aiming to be the best Coordinator.
en: \bI'm aiming to be the best Coordinator.

id: \bThe contest was amazing! I wish I entered.
en: \bThe contest was amazing! I wish I entered.
it: \bLa Gara è stata fantastica! Vorrei essermi iscritto.

id: \rI only needed one more ribbon to win. What am I going to do now?
en: \rI only needed one more ribbon to win. What am I going to do now?
it: \rMi mancava solo un fiocco per vincere. Che cosa faccio adesso?
